questions.title: Disagreement with a teammate
questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate or lead on a technical decision. What happened?
expectedConcepts: Listening to and understanding the other view
Data or experiments to resolve it
questions.answerOutline: A concrete situation, the candidate's own actions (seeking data, proposing a test, escalating appropriately), a clear result, and reflection.
commonMistakes: A story where they were simply right and the other person wrong
followUps: What if you had lost the argument?
questions.rubricNotes: Score ownership and collaboration, not who won.

questions.title: Ownership under pressure
questions.prompt: Describe a production incident or a deadline crisis you handled. What did you personally do?
questions.answerOutline: Stabilise first, communicate status, find the root cause, add tests and monitoring afterwards, and run a blameless review.
followUps: How did you communicate with stakeholders?
What metric told you it was fixed?
questions.rubricNotes: Look for specific actions with measurable impact.

questions.title: Learning something fast
questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new technology quickly to deliver something.
questions.answerOutline: A specific technology, how they ramped up (docs, small prototype, asking experts), what they shipped, and the lessons learned.
followUps: How do you know when you know enough to start?
